source_caption_text:
Drake trolled Ben and told him he’s too old to be put into college jail 😭😂😂

Via: @bendadonnn 

During his stream, Drake started trolling BenDaDonnn about his recent arrest after the Texas A&M game, joking that he was too old to be in “campus jail” 😂 Ben pushed back on that, explaining he wasn’t arrested on campus and was actually about eight miles away. He also said the jail staff ended up taking good care of him during his time there, but added that he plans to sue the police over the incident. The two went back and forth on the livestream, with Drake cracking jokes while Ben clarified what happened and shared more about his experience 😭👀
